text:
June (PM): Quick sync: users still can't find invoices on Usage. Two proposals: keep cards+chart, or switch to compact ledger with a persistent invoice CTA. Which preserves discoverability?
Alex (Design): Compact ledger + sticky header CTA. Keep header primary: 'Download invoice (PDF)'. Per-row small CSV icon for engineers.
Owen (Analytics): Data: header CTA gets 2.1x more clicks than per-row. Moving CTA below fold reduces downloads. Keep it visible.
Rina (Frontend): Implementation note: sticky CTA trivial. Per-row icons need roving tabindex to avoid tab bloat. Also sparklines should be canvas for long lists.
a11y-bot: Accessibility: scope switch must announce changes (aria-live) and segmented token toggle needs 4.5:1 contrast + role=tablist semantics.
June (PM): Copy tweak: header "Download invoice (PDF)"; row tooltips "Download usage (CSV)" — explicit formats.
Alex (Design): Visual: compact rows at 8px vertical rhythm, 44px sparkline column, per-row action icons 24px tappable. Add "Latest billed: Apr 2026" under CTA.
Rina (Frontend): Will prototype roving tabindex and lazy-render sparklines. Also add aria-labels to mini-charts: "Project X 0030-day spend".
Owen (Analytics): Also A/B test role-defaults for token vs USD display. We'll measure invoice downloads and support searches for "invoice".
June (PM): Action items: Alex update mocks, Rina prototype, Owen set up experiment. Quick follow-up tomorrow 9:30. Thanks all.
